class.name: VehicleAudio
class.brief_description: Bounded procedural waveguide audio player driven by a Vehicle telemetry stream.
class.description: VehicleAudio compiles [VehicleAudioTopologyData] and [VehicleAudioFiringData] once during [method Node._ready] into a fixed-memory waveguide network and four-stroke scheduler. Source events retain the authored pulse width as their baseline while event-time RPM/throttle shaping derives bounded width and attack changes; the Vehicle adapter scales pressure by [code]0.1 + 0.9 * throttle[/code] and uses a resettable four-value deterministic gain cycle without RNG or cadence changes. Guides compile broadband and per-direction high-frequency loss; the output tap selects post-scattering node pressure or boundary radiation. It renders a 48 kHz [AudioStreamGenerator] in bounded staging blocks and applies a fixed 20 Hz DC blocker, 6.5 kHz low-pass, and [code]tanh[/code] conditioner. Invalid or missing resources disable audio; topology validation and coefficient derivation are setup-only, and resource edits take effect after node re-entry or a new setup.

method.name: set_target
method.description: Sets the Vehicle whose engine RPM and throttle drive firing and pulse amplitude.

method.name: get_target
method.description: Returns the assigned or automatically discovered target Vehicle.

method.name: set_topology
method.description: Sets the topology resource compiled during setup.

method.name: set_firing
method.description: Sets the four-stroke phase and source-routing resource compiled during setup.

method.name: is_audio_enabled
method.description: Returns true after topology, firing, generator, and playback setup succeeds.

members.member: Vehicle providing engine RPM and throttle telemetry. If unset, the parent and then sibling nodes are searched during setup.
Waveguide nodes, guides, source mappings, output tap node, and NodePressure/BoundaryRadiation output mode to compile.
720-degree firing phases, source names, pulse gains, and source pulse width to compile.
